    Up to 30m³ – Standard UK use (May–September)

product.name: Copper Brake Pipe Repair Kit Flaring Tool Bender M10 DIN suitable for Porsche 914 All Years
product.description:
This professional kit includes everything you need to repair and replace old corroded brake pipes. 
Suitable for Porsche 914 all years. (M10 Unions with DIN Flare). 
British made flaring tool with precision machined punch and die blocks produces an OEM specification DIN pipe flare the same as the original. 
Flaring tool can be used on the car in-situ allowing pipes to be joined on the car and be replaced in smaller sections. 
High quality pipe bender designed specifically for brake pipes makes it easy to form neat and accurate bends in the brake pipe.
Correctly sized 3/16" (4.75mm) pipe bender ensures a consistent internal diameter right across the bend compared to oversized pipe benders designed for plumbing. 
Suitable for vehicles with M10 x 1mm brake fittings using the DIN flare. Will not produce SAE Single or Double Flares. (See photo for flare types) 
Kit Includes; 
● Professional hand held flaring tool. 
● A 25ft (7.6m) roll of 3/16" (4.75mm) Copper Brake Line (Conforms to BS EN 12449, 3120 PSI Max Working Pressure) 
● 10 x Male Brake Pipe Fitting Unions M10 x 1mm. 
● 2 x Female Inline Pipe Joiners M10 x 1mm. 
● Professional brake pipe bender, correctly sized for brake pipes. 
● Mini brake pipe tubing cutter.
Includes everything required to professionally repair and replace old brake pipes. 
Note; Brake lines are a safety critical component and should only be repaired or made by competent persons with sufficient knowledge and experience to complete the work to a safe standard. Always double check the new fitting and pipe flare is identical to the original.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Push Fit Brass Coupler 15mm X 1/2 - Pack of 4 for Easy Pipe Connections
product.description: Discover the convenience of the John Guest Speedfit Brass Male Coupler, expertly designed for seamless connections between metric pipes using a male thread. This innovative push-fit coupler allows for effortless installation—simply push it onto a plastic or copper pipe for a secure fit. When you need to demount the connection, just push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release it. Ideal for confined spaces, this coupler offers a quicker and safer alternative to traditional methods, eliminating the need for hot works and ensuring a flame-free installation with no glue or flux required. Manufactured in the UK, this durable coupler is compatible with Speedfit PEX and polybutylene plastic pipes (inserts needed) as well as copper pipes. It is suitable for both hot and cold water systems, making it perfect for central heating applications. Each pack contains 4 couplers, ensuring you have everything you need for your plumbing projects.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Red - 800mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner and outer layer and reinforced with 3 or 4 plies of polyester braid, these couplers deliver exceptional strength, flexibility, and reliability. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Water Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 17m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Water Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground water pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant plastic mesh, it features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed warning text. The highly visible mesh helps identify buried water pipe routes when exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, it provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams, helping to identify underground services during construction and groundworks. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground water pipe routes before or during excavation. Its durable, rot-resistant construction is designed to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for service identification. Suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers, this detectable warning mesh provides a practical way to mark buried water pipes and improve visibility of underground services. Certified to EN 12613. PLEASE NOTE - Images are for illustrative purposes only.

product.name: Terma Electric Towel Rail ZIG ZAG (Wi-Fi) 835h x 500w(mm)  Salt n Pepper Grey 300w
product.description: Zig Zag oil filled electric towel rail supplied with the Terma VEO element controller is the very latest wifi technology from Terma, controlled via the free Terma SMART app (ios/android). Compatible with Alexa, Google Assistant and IFTTT. No hub is required as element will connect direct to the app via Wi-Fi. Requires a 2.4ghz wifi network to conect and setup the element (which may need to be switched on by your internet service provider) this can be turned off once connected. Zig Zag is an original Terma product design with horizontal bars set at an angle so you place your towel over the top bar. Offers 5 room temperature settings (15 to 28 °C), a Drying function and a full 7-day timer. The Smart system consists only of heating devices and sensors and no additional hub is required.  Also fully compatible with Alexa, Google Assistant and IFTTT). The Salt n Pepper colour from Terma has a matt, rough texture.  Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. The smart split (SS1) heating probe is pre fitted inside the electric towel rail, on the right side (can be moved to left side if required). The VEO controller simply pushes on and can be rotated to view. The clamshell casing on the VEO element is in a matching or complimentary colour to the electric towel rail. The Terma SMART App includes geolocation to automatically lower the temperature by 3-4°C when you leave and return to comfort mode as you approach home. It offers a full 7-day timer, a 2-hour drying function with auto shut-off, and a holiday mode accessible via the app. Compliant with Lot20 Eco-design Directive for electric radiators with adaptive start control. Straight 1.5m cable, pre fitted with a UK 3 pin plug for ease of installation next to a plug (if non bathroom i.e. utility room etc) (remove plug if being installed in a bathroom). IPx5 (safe for use in bathroom).Class 1. UKCA Approved. Guarantee: 2 Years.

product.description: Terma electric towel rail supplied with the Terma ONE element - completely internalised, minimalist heating element hidden from show at the bottom of the rail. Features a 2hr drying function. Compatible with external timer as remembers settings when off. The White RAL 9016 colour has a silk, smooth finish. Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. Features 1x discreet underside control button & miniature front  facing LED panel pre fitted to the right hand side. Note: This cannot be moved to the left hand side. Supplied with matching white cable. IPx5 (safe for use in bathroom). Oil filled. Class 1. UKCA Approved. Trades can wire this in within minutes, no commissioning or lengthy instructions. All electronic components have been moved up and inside the right vertical bar, so compared to other standard electric towel rails on the market there are no external parts on show at the bottom; as a result the lowest horizontal bar is for decorative purposesonly and does not contain any oil so does not heat up - the rail will still give the listed output regardless of this fact.

For more advanced built in timer control we suggest you look at the other models of heating element Terma provides (i.e. MOA Blue). As this rail is flat, it can be flipped so the element is on the left. Stainless steel head with grey cable. IP67 (safe for use in bathroom). Class 1. UKCA Approved. Trades can wire this in within minutes, no commissioning or lengthy instructions.

Available in sizes ranging from 3mm to 25mm internal diameter, it is suitable for use across various domestic, industrial, and laboratory settings. Each hose provides consistent wall thickness and smooth bore for reliable flow, supported by a durable design with no reinforcement, keeping weight to a minimum. The hose performs optimally within a temperature range of -10°C to +65°C, with a peak tolerance of up to +70°C. The hose accommodates bending radii from 20mm to 180mm depending on the size selected, and supports working pressures up to 1.5 Bar and burst pressures up to 4.5 Bar. Whether you're irrigating your garden, setting up water cooling systems, or routing air lines in workshop settings, this transparent hose offers a clean, easy-to-use, and durable solution.

product.description:
Wet Area Hygiene Mat for Barefoot - "Anti-Slip" in a Range of Colours, 2 Widths
Antibacterial and non-slip swimming pool and sauna runner
When designing the environment in publicly accessible wet areas two factors should never be neglected: Safety and hygiene. Wherever moisture is carried around and comes into contact with the floor, there is a risk of slip accidents and the development and spread of germs. The solution: the anti-slip hygiene mats "Anti-Slip".
Anti-slip mat for wet areas - can be used indoors and outdoors
Thanks to the antibacterial coating, these hygiene mats, which are available in customised sizes, counteract the growth and spread of bacteria and fungi. The extremely non-slip and open wave structure of the antibacterial runners ensures that water and other liquids can flow off unhindered. For this reason, the hygiene mat is not only suitable for use in swimming pools or saunas, but also in showers and changing rooms where the safety of visitors must be ensured. The flame-retardant wet-room mat can also be used outdoors due to its UV and temperature resistance (-5° C to 60° C).
Cleaning and care are uncomplicated. All that is needed is water and a cleaning agent. The open structure allows the anti-slip mat to dry quickly afterwards.

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Keyed-Alike Euro Cylinders - Chrome, 45/50 (95mm), 2 Extra (7 total)
product.description: Pair of high security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ keyed-alike euro cylinders combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ holds Secured by Design accreditation and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacks. Kinetica+ uses a variety of specially engineered, hardened steel anti-bump, drill, and pick pins, whilst its core is reinforced by a super-strong strengthening bar that ensures a robust and durable lock. Lock snapping is a huge concern, so Kinetica+ combines several defensive mechanisms. A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.

product.name: Aluminium Beaded Hose Connector for Silicone Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes (25mm OD, 400mm Long)
product.description: Our Beaded Aluminium Hose Joiners (Swaged Connectors) provide a robust and professional solution for joining hoses in high-pressure or high-temperature applications. Manufactured from high-grade 6063 aluminium, these joiners feature swaged ends with precision-formed beads to prevent hose blow-off and ensure a secure fit under boost or vacuum conditions. The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: Terma Radiator Forte (DOUBLE Panel), 600h x 1254w (mm), White RAL 9016
product.description: Forte is a flat bar range of designer radiators available in both single or double panel variants; each bar is 70mm wide with a small gap which creates a very seamless looking design set against the wall. This Forte double panel (V20) model is manufactured from a double layer of flat steel profiles mounted on round rear collectors, with a very shallow projection of just 93mm including fixings, meaning this model is well suited to spaces where the overall projection is limited. Note: Terma also offer a Forte single panel model (V10) which has a lower projection of 73mm. This white (RAL 9016) colour has a silk, smooth texture. Terma offers a 150x50mm colour chip of this finish should you wish to see the colour prior to purchase. The Forte range have the unique feature that they can be installed either... vertically with the bars running up and down (valves connected on the sides)... or they can be installed horizontally with the bars running left to right (valves connected on the undersides). The same physical model you buy can be installed either way up giving maximum flexibility dependant on your space requirements. See the images for how the radiators look each way up as they can give a very different looking design as you rotate each model and we show images of these fitted both ways for every size. Forte is supplied with a universal bracket which allows the radiator to be installed either way up, full instructions supplied. As you rotate the radiator either way up it changes the view you will have of the brackets from the side of the radiator. With the bars running vertically the brackets are on show, but with the bars running horizontally the brackets are fully concealed from view. See the images for this difference. Forte is pre fitted with an internal diverter (baffle) which is a barrier to aid the flow of water up and over inside the radiator to ensure even heat distribution across all bars.

product.name: Plum&Clay Corwin Horizontal Radiator Rustic Copper Triple Column Traditional Cast Iron Style Radiator (W)785mm (H)300mm
product.description:
The Corwin radiator is a traditional style masterpiece that effortlessly combines timeless elegance with modern functionality. Inspired by the conic cast iron radiators, this horizontal wonder is here to revolutionise your space with its classic charm.

With a triple column design and made from high quality mild steel, Corwin guarantees an exceptional heat output, ensuring your room stays cozy and warm even on the coldest of days.

With its traditional columns and cast iron look, this radiator pays homage to the timeless designs that came before it. Finished in a rustic copper colour, this classic touch adds a touch of refinement to any interior, effortlessly blending in with both contemporary and traditional decor.

To complete the traditional style, optional radiator feet are available to purchase separately.

Standard ½ inch pipe threads have been used for easy installation with most radiator valves.

Please note: As the rustic copper finish is applied by hand, slight variations in colour and appearance may occur, giving each radiator its own unique character.

Please note that radiator valves are not included with this product, allowing you the flexibility to choose valves that suit your preferences.
